scheme_name: Scheme of Extending Grants for the Publication of Rare Books on Arts
other_conditions: Applicant must lack sufficient financial resources to cover publishing expenses
The book must be considered rare for the development of arts
The book must not have been previously published
Grant is not given for reprint
benefits_summary: 60% of printing cost up to ₹15,000, paid in two equal installments.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
